function.name: bash

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

"""unitcalc — small unit-conversion helpers used across Northreach services."""
from .core import convert, LENGTH_UNITS

__all__ = ["convert", "LENGTH_UNITS"]
"""Core unit-conversion routines."""

# Conversion factors to meters.
LENGTH_UNITS = {
    "m": 1.0,
    "km": 1000.0,
    "cm": 0.01,
    "mm": 0.001,
    "mi": 1609.344,
    "ft": 0.3048,
    "in": 0.0254,
}


def convert(value, from_unit, to_unit):
    """Convert ``value`` from ``from_unit`` to ``to_unit`` (length units)."""
    if from_unit not in LENGTH_UNITS or to_unit not in LENGTH_UNITS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown unit: {from_unit!r} -> {to_unit!r}")
    return value * LENGTH_UNITS[from_unit] / LENGTH_UNITS[to_unit]
